title: Tidy up the computer
drDigitalIntro:
This is your assessment for this unit. There are no step-by-step instructions this time — just a list of things to accomplish.

- Nothing will glow yellow. You decide where to click.
- You can do the objectives in any order.
- Open the objectives list with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
- If you get stuck, the Hint button gives you a nudge — not the answer.

The files are scattered around Home, Documents, and Pictures. Look in each place.

playgroundTask.goal: You tidied the files on your own
playgroundTask.hint: The left-hand list moves you between places. The buttons along the top act on whichever file you have selected — so select first, then click.

steps.say: VacationPhoto.png belongs with the other pictures. Put it there.
Sunset.png has a vague name. Rename it Sunset-Over-Water.png.
Letter.docx is junk. Throw it away.
Find FavoriteSong.mp3 without browsing for it.

drDigitalSuccess: You created, moved, renamed, deleted, and searched — that is every file skill in the unit, sequenced by you rather than by me.
drDigitalHint: Sunset.png is in Pictures and Letter.docx is in Documents. To rename or delete, click the file once to select it, then use the buttons at the top.
